payload.reason: The evidence provides a comprehensive overview of various types of offensive content explored in social media, including specific categories and targets of such content.

claims.text: Offensive content includes hate speech, cyberbullying, cyber-aggression, toxic comments, and abusive language.
The types of offensive language are categorized as targeted insults (TIN) and untargeted profanity (UNT).
Targets of offensive content can be individuals (IND), groups (GRP), or other entities (OTH).
